projectDescription: An async RPC framework for Rust that lets you define services as traits, generates client and server boilerplate, and supports pluggable transports with built-in cancellation, deadlines, and distributed tracing.
keyFeatures: Schema-in-code: define RPC services as Rust traits using the #[tarpc::service] attribute macro
Pluggable transport: any Stream + Sink implementation can serve as a transport
Cascading cancellation: dropping a request future sends cancellation to the server and propagates through dependencies
Configurable deadlines with automatic propagation across service chains
Distributed tracing via tracing + OpenTelemetry integration
Optional Serde serialization (serde1 feature) with JSON and Bincode formats
Server-side request hooks (before/after/before_and_after) for cross-cutting concerns
Client stubs with load balancing (RoundRobin, ConsistentHash) and retry support
In-process channel transport for zero-serialization testing
publicApiSurface: #[tarpc::service] — attribute macro that generates service trait, client stub, and request/response types
tarpc::client::NewClient<C, D> — client + dispatch pair returned by client::new()
tarpc::client::stub::Stub — trait for types that can call remote services
tarpc::server::serve() — wraps a closure into a Serve impl
tarpc::server::incoming::Incoming — extension trait for streams of channels
tarpc::server::incoming::spawn_incoming() — spawns all channels via Tokio
tarpc::context::Context — request-scoped deadline and trace context
tarpc::context::current() — returns the current request context
tarpc::transport::channel::unbounded() — creates an in-process unbounded channel transport
tarpc::serde_transport — Serde-based transport over AsyncRead+AsyncWrite streams
tarpc::serde_transport::unix — Unix domain socket connect/listen helpers
tarpc::Transport — sealed bidirectional Stream+Sink transport trait
tarpc::ServerError — error type returned by server handlers
